description: Human review of sampled traces graded by Judge.FaithfulnessJudge. Reviewers answer the same faithfulness criterion the judge uses, so the two verdicts can be compared. Answers write back onto each trace.

questions.title: Is EVERY factual claim supported by the evidence? (pass = all claims grounded; fail = any unsupported, hallucinated, truncated or unverifiable claim)

Evidence you checked the output against. Paste it here: when labels are imported into Judges > Human alignment, every answer except the pass/fail one reaches the judge as {{ expectations }}, so this is how the judge sees the same evidence you did.

notes: Create the queue under Operate > Review Queues, add the trace ids (the 50 traces written by assets/seed_traces.py), and answer each item. Keep the 'faithful' wording aligned with judges/faithfulness-judge.judge.json so pass/fail maps to the judge's true/false. The pass/fail answer is the label; every OTHER answer on the item is passed to the judge as {{ expectations }} by Import labels, so keep it to the evidence. A reviewer's explanation that quotes the unsupported claim would become 'evidence' (see the README, 'Common errors').
